user.title: Add Kestrel
user.description: Kestrel lets an Amazfit / Zepp OS watch control things you point at. After adding it, open Kestrel on the watch and choose Pair: Home Assistant will show a pairing code to enter on the watch. Each paired watch appears as a device; delete the device to unpair it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Kestrel is already set up. Pair more watches from the watch itself.

init.title: Kestrel
init.description: Kestrel works on your home network (or a VPN into it), never through Home Assistant Cloud.

offered.title: Devices for watches
offered.description: Choose what watches can paint and trigger: whole devices, or single entities (for example one light of a fixture). Leave both empty to offer everything that a watch can trigger. Configuration and diagnostic entities, and hidden or disabled ones, are never offered. Watches get the new list when they next sync.

data_description.devices: Every light, switch, lock and so on of these devices.
data_description.entities: Single entities, on top of the devices.

watch.title: {watch}
watch.description: What would you like to manage? Changes reach the watch the next time it syncs (Sync on the watch's home screen).

take_over.title: Take over another watch's setup
take_over.description: Give {watch} the paints, rooms and settings of another watch, for a watch that was paired again as a new one, or a new watch. Picking a paired watch makes {watch} take its place: it keeps that watch's device and entities (so automations keep working), and the device {watch} has now is removed. A removed watch's setup is copied in. The watch picks it up at its next sync.

paints.title: Painted devices
paints.description: Remove a paint that went wrong, or make a paint trigger a different entity.

data_description.action: "Remove the newest spot" undoes the last paint of this device and keeps the others.

reassign.title: Trigger a different entity
reassign.description: The spots painted for {device} will trigger this entity instead.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Delete a room's Bluetooth calibration, for example after moving furniture or devices. Calibrate it again on the watch under More → Rooms.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Calibrating a gesture on the watch (More → Gesture) sets its thresholds; each gesture keeps its own. The thresholds below are for the current gesture ({kind}): raise them if it triggers too easily, lower them if it's too hard. Leave both empty to forget its calibration.

data.gesture_gyro: Gyro threshold (°/s) for the current gesture
data.gesture_jolt: Jolt threshold for the current gesture

data_description.gesture_gyro: How fast the wrist must turn. Leave empty to not use the gyro.
data_description.gesture_jolt: How sharp a jolt the accelerometer must feel. Leave empty to not use it.
data_description.room_source: The watch's own Bluetooth room calibration, or a sensor whose state is an area name (for example from Bermuda).
data_description.room_sensor: A sensor whose state is the name of the area the watch (or you) is in.
data_description.gesture_kind: Switches at once to that gesture's own calibration. Snaps and taps need calibrating on the watch first.
data_description.dwell_enabled: Trigger a device just by holding the aim on it, with no button or gesture. Locks still need a press.
data_description.dwell_seconds: How long to hold the aim before it triggers. Longer means fewer accidents.
data_description.open_on_point: Start the app on Point instead of the home screen, for launching it from the watch's shortcut key. Back goes to the home screen.
data_description.learn: Each trigger that wasn't corrected sharpens that device's paint a little, and confident room checks keep room calibrations up to date.
data_description.volume_max: Twisting at a media player never raises its volume above this. Turning it down always works.
data_description.volume_step: The most one twist can change the volume by, however far the wrist turns. Twists are also at least a second apart.
data_description.screen_seconds: How long Kestrel's screens stay on without a touch, whatever the watch's own screen timeout. Point also keeps it on while you aim.
data_description.detailed_diagnostics: The watch also sends its aim traces, screen and button trail and room scans, for the diagnostics download. Turns itself off after a week. Errors are always kept.

abort.no_paints: This watch hasn't painted any devices yet.
abort.no_rooms: This watch hasn't calibrated any rooms yet. Calibrate them on the watch under More → Rooms.

error.sensor_needed: Choose the sensor that says which room you're in.

options.remove_last: Remove the newest spot (a bad paint)

watch_unpaired.message: This watch is no longer paired with Kestrel. Pair it again from the watch.
